name: agents-trust
description: Find which paid x402 API to call for a task, with live evidence. Free demo for weather, crypto prices and web search; other answers return a 0.01 USDC quote and pay only after wallet-owner opt-in.

wallet_key.title: Wallet private key
wallet_key.description: Optional Base USDC wallet key; payments also require explicit owner opt-in.

enable_payments.title: Allow one payment authorization
enable_payments.description: Owner grant for one authorization per process, including failed or uncertain submissions. Restarting resets this grant. No per-call confirmation.
